## 2. Room Options and Pricing
All fees are quoted per resident per month in Nepalese Rupees (NPR).
All room fees include 4 meals daily, optical fibre Wi-Fi, 24/7 hot water, electricity, power backup, and laundry.

1. **Single Seater Room**
   - Monthly Fee: NPR 18,000 / month
   - Details: Private independent room for students requiring maximum focus. Includes personal wooden bed, comfortable mattress, private study desk with LED lamp, lockable wardrobe, attached private bathroom, and large sunny window.

2. **Double Seater Room**
   - Monthly Fee: NPR 14,500 / month
   - Details: Shared with one roommate. Individual wooden beds, separate dedicated study tables, individual wardrobes, and sunny window view.

3. **Triple Seater Room**
   - Monthly Fee: NPR 12,500 / month
   - Details: Most popular choice. Three beds, personal study tables, shoe racks, and balcony access.

4. **Four Seater Room**
   - Monthly Fee: NPR 11,000 / month
   - Details: Budget-friendly option for classmates and friends joining together. Lockable wardrobes, study tables, and airy environment.

Admission Fee: One-time NPR 5,000 registration fee. A refundable security deposit equivalent to one month's rent is held and refunded upon checkout.

## 3. Meal Routine (4 Fresh Meals Daily)
Food is prepared on-site in a modern, stainless-steel hygienic kitchen with 5-stage Reverse Osmosis (RO) filtered water.
- **7:00 AM – 8:30 AM**: Morning Tea & Breakfast (Milk/black tea, boiled eggs, toast, butter, jam, chana-roti).
- **9:30 AM – 10:30 AM**: Midday Dal Bhat (Steaming rice, yellow dal, seasonal green saag, fresh vegetable curry, homemade achar).
- **4:30 PM – 5:30 PM**: Afternoon Tiffin / Snacks (Hot tea with momos, veg chowmein, fresh samosas, or pakodas).
- **7:30 PM – 8:45 PM**: Evening Dinner (Nepali Dal Bhat set, chicken curry served on Wednesdays and Sundays, fresh paneer curry on Fridays, mixed curries on other days).

## 4. Key Amenities & Facilities
- **Dual-Band High-Speed Wi-Fi**: Dedicated fibre routers on every single residential floor with battery backup.
- **24/7 Security & Biometric Access**: HD CCTV cameras in all corridors, stairs, and main gate. Biometric entry control, on-site resident warden, and night security guard.
- **Solar & Geyser Hot Water**: Year-round continuous hot water powered by rooftop solar thermal arrays with electric backup for cold winter mornings.
- **Quiet Study Hall**: Air-conditioned ground-floor study room with individual study carrels, glare-free lamps, and device charging sockets. Open until midnight.
- **Inverter Power Backup**: Pure sine-wave inverter backup powers Wi-Fi and study lights during municipal load-shedding.
- **Rooftop Automatic Laundry**: Automatic washing machines and spacious covered and sunny clothes drying lines.
- **5-Stage RO Filtered Water**: Purified drinking water stations on every floor with cold, normal, and hot water taps.

## 5. Rules & Discipline
- **Gate Closing Time**: 8:30 PM sharp every night. Late entry requires prior written approval from the warden.
- **Silence Hours**: 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM strictly observed for study and sleep.
- **Visitor Hours**: Parents and guardians are welcome in the ground-floor visitor lounge from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
- **Strict Prohibition**: Smoking, tobacco, alcohol, drugs, gambling, and harassment carry immediate expulsion.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: Where is The Purple Nest Hostel located?**
  **A**: The hostel is situated at Sinpa Marg, Gwarko, Lalitpur, Bagmati Province 44700, Nepal, directly accessible from Gwarko Chowk and Ring Road, providing fast connections to colleges across Lalitpur and Kathmandu Valley.
- **Q: Are meals included in the monthly fee?**
  **A**: Yes, all four daily meals (breakfast, lunch, afternoon snacks, and dinner) are fully included in the monthly fee.
- **Q: Can parents inspect the hostel before admission?**
  **A**: Yes, walk-in visits and room tours are open daily from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
- **Q: How can I contact The Purple Nest Hostel?**
  **A**: Call or WhatsApp +977 976-1158651, email stayatthepurplenest@gmail.com, or visit https://thepurplenesthostel.com/contact.
